title: Nothing you can see: two Indiana Avenue lots looked up for 1904
items: Nothing you can see changes. The 1911 atlas shows a one-storey post office at 1925-1929 Indiana Avenue, but the 1902 and 1911 city directories both list people living at 1927, so a house let in rooms stood there in 1904 and the post office came later. The lots stay empty until a plan or picture of that house turns up.

The corner store at 1935-1937 and the flats behind it on 20th Street are not found in any directory before 1910, which suggests they were built around 1909. That is not proof, so the corner stays empty for now.
